provenance.selectionRule: Use the Harness sidebar shell, style module, and collapse/pointer-scrollbar tests as source; no VCP sidebar consumer is added while shell work is owned elsewhere.

candidateStatus: source-only; Harness sidebar shell contract captured, no VCP consumer, paired capture, or pixel parity claim
tree: div.root > div.logoRow + button.newSession + div.regionArea[sidebar.workspaces slot] + div.footArea[sidebar.footer.action + sidebar.settings slots]

aria.brand: button with localized new-session aria-label while wide
aria.newSession: button with localized new-session aria-label; rail tooltip when collapsed

ownership.collapse: caller owns collapsed/width/startSession/toggleSidebar; shell owns 150ms settled-wide presentation state
ownership.scrollbars: shell owns pointer-inside state and 2000ms linger timer; rebinds only inherited scrollbar custom properties
ownership.slots: workspace/sidebar footer/settings registrants own their rendered business content

vcpBoundary: Reference only; do not mount into VCP shell or modify sidebar/session/settings consumers.
